newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait firm plans $50 mln Lebanon JV Islamic bank.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait firm plans $50 mln Lebanon JV Islamic bank.

text.p: Kuwait Finance House (KFH) and the Islamic Development Bank (IDB) plan to establish a $50 million joint venture Islamic bank in Lebanon, a newspaper reported on Saturday.
KFH, an Islamic finance institution that carries out banking activities, is waiting for the approval of the Lebanese parliamnet to start the project, a KFH official told al-Watan newspaper.
KFH plans to take 40 percent of the $50 million bank shares, IDB will take 20 percent and the rest will be put to a public offering, he said.
Islamic banking depends on profit sharing with depositors instead of paying interest, in line with the teachings of Islam which bars interest dealings.
The 50-member Saudi Arabia-based IDB was established in 1975 to promote trade exchanges between Islamic states.
The official said KFH was also considering a consumer finance firm in Lebanon. He did not elaborate.
